cases.note: The array loop preserves the original descending threshold chain (PB→KB, default B) exactly; boundary values across all units behave identically to pristine.
Equivalent refactor: the precomputed slice(2) is only used in the 0b/0o/0x branches where it matches the original inline slice exactly, and the decimal path is unchanged.
The mutation removes the typeof check, so non-string values with a length property (e.g. an array) are passed to parse instead of throwing an Error, as the pristine version does.
